title: Mechanical Properties of Inflamed Appendix Tissues
use: Prior and virtual-coupon protocol only; not fitted or validated simulator material
sample: Frozen/thawed human appendix; control fragments from one appendix, three independent appendices per inflamed group

sample_counts.purulent: 3 fragments, one from each of 3 separate appendices
sample_counts.gangrenous: 3 fragments, one from each of 3 separate appendices

handling.freeze_thaw: Samples frozen after excision and thawed before measurement

limitations: Raw curves not obtained; licensing of downloadable data not verified
AFM luminal microscale modulus is not a whole-wall FEM Young modulus
No direct grasp, tear, cutting or in-vivo force reference
Compression stiffening and shear weakening require nonlinear model validation
